items.title: Skift Transatlantic Summit: Five Decisions in the Room
items.snippet: Skift Take: The transatlantic corridor remains one of travel’s most important markets — and also one of the most exposed to global disruption. Geopolitics, rising costs, changing traveler behavior, and new technology are forcing companies to rethink where new growth will come from. Europe’s international arrivals were up 5.0% year-to-date in 2026, but performance varies sharply by market and region.

items.title: What RevPAR misses about hotel revenue
items.snippet: TRevPAR declined 8.8% vs RevPAR's 6.3% in HotelData's 2025 U.S. sample, illustrating how room-only metrics obscure F&B, spa, parking, and other in-stay revenue trends.

items.title: American Express Announces Its Largest Centurion Lounge Expansion Yet
items.snippet: American Express is launching its largest Centurion expansion yet, adding lounges at Newark and Heathrow while dramatically enlarging Philadelphia and Houston as premium airport competition intensifies.

items.title: IHCL Signs 232-Key Gateway Hotel in Agra
items.snippet: Indian Hotels Company (IHCL) has signed a greenfield project for a 232-key Gateway hotel in Agra, Uttar Pradesh , in partnership with Raj Kailash Hospitality LLP. Located along the Yamuna Expressway, Gateway Agra will feature an all-day dining restaurant, specialty restaurant and bar, along with a gym and swimming pool.

items.title: Non-hotel brands dominate India’s branded residences market but hotel brands are gaining ground, says report
items.snippet: India has 61 branded residential schemes, comprising 24 completed developments and 37 in the pipeline, making it the third largest market in Asia-Pacific behind Thailand and Vietnam. Unlike the wider region, however, where hotel brands continue to dominate, 61 percent of India's schemes carry non-hotel brands, against 22 percent across Asia-Pacific and 24 percent globally, said a report by GBR.

items.title: FHS World 2027 returns to Ras Al Khaimah in 2027
items.snippet: FHS World, a leading global hospitality investment summit, will return to Ras Al Khaimah in November 2027, bringing investors, developers, hotel operators and industry leaders from around the world to Wynn Al Marjan Island. The event is being jointly announced by Ras Al Khaimah Tourism Development Authority (RAKTDA), Marjan and The Bench, organiser of FHS World.

items.title: Execs at Lodging Conference discuss hotel development opportunities
items.snippet: Chief development officers from Wyndham, IHG, Choice and more shared the growth prospects behind conversions and extended stay amid an unfavorable backdrop for owners. PHOENIX — Although hotel developers are concerned about owner profitability, deals are still being made in 2026, with some executives sharing optimism for the year ahead, including for new builds.

items.title: GST Council widens ITC scope, eases refund norms
items.snippet: The GST Council has approved a series of measures to widen input tax credit (ITC) eligibility and ease refund rules, with potential implications for businesses across sectors. At its 57th meeting, the Council allowed ITC on health and life insurance purchased for employees, as well as on telecommunication towers and pipelines installed outside factory premises.

items.title: Sri Lanka: An Island of Opportunities
items.snippet: Sri Lanka: An Island of Opportunities by Hotelivate | Oct 7, 2026 Sri Lanka has long been one of Asia’s most distinctive tourism destinations. Few markets offer the same combination of beaches, wildlife, mountains, culture and religious heritage within such a compact geography. This diversity has helped the country attract a broad range of travellers and made tourism an important contributor to the national economy.

items.title: BeKind Hotels and Resorts introduces Diwali experiences at Meyyafushi and Fushifaru Maldives
items.snippet: BeKind Hotels and Resorts has introduced a series of Diwali experiences at Meyyafushi Maldives and Fushifaru Maldives, offering Indian travellers festive dining and private celebrations across its island resorts. At Meyyafushi Maldives, guests will have the option to exclusively hire a secluded sandbank for a private Diwali celebration with family and friends.
